title: Pure Barian's
summary: The Barian's strategy revolves around the 'Seventh' Spells and 'Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force' to cheat out the iconic Over-Hundred Numbers (Number 101 through 107) and rank them up into Chaos Numbers. This pure build pairs Barian's Chaos Draw and Seventh Tachyon with the Level 4 WATER/Shark engine to swarm Rank 4s and summon CXyz Barian Hope with up to 7000 ATK.

allow.Silent Angler: Special Summons itself if you control a WATER monster to make an instant Rank 4 Over-Hundred Number.
allow.Abyss Shark: Special Summons itself if you control only WATER monsters and searches a Level 3, 4, or 5 Fish, doubling Number battle damage.
allow.Crystal Shark: Special Summons itself from hand or GY by targeting a WATER monster and can be used as a Level 3 or 4 for Number Xyz Summons.
allow.Buzzsaw Shark: Summons a Level 4 Fish from the Deck to immediately make Number 101 or Number 103.
allow.Number 101: Silent Honor ARK: Iconic Over-Hundred Number that detaches 2 materials to attach an opponent's Special Summoned monster.
allow.Number C101: Silent Honor DARK: Chaos Number that attaches an opposing monster without detaching and revives itself while gaining LP.
allow.Number 103: Ragnazero: Over-Hundred Number that destroys an opponent's monster with modified ATK and draws a card.
allow.Number C103: Ragnafinity: Chaos Number that burns the opponent and banishes their monster when its ATK changes.
allow.Number 104: Masquerade: Over-Hundred Number that negates monster effects during the Battle Phase and mills.
allow.Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade: Chaos Number that pops a Spell/Trap on summon and negates monster effects while halving opponent's LP.
allow.Number 106: Giant Hand: Over-Hundred Number that detaches 2 materials to negate an opponent's monster effect.
allow.Number C106: Giant Red Hand: Chaos Number that negates all other face-up cards on the field as a Quick Effect.
allow.N.As.H. Knight: Rank 5 Xyz representing Nash that attaches an Over-Hundred Number from Extra Deck and an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect.
allow.CXyz N.As.Ch. Knight: Rank 6 Chaos Xyz that ranks up over N.As.H. Knight and summons any Chaos Number from the Extra Deck.
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos: Quick-Play Rank-Up-Magic that ranks up a Number into its Chaos counterpart during the Battle Phase.

main: Abyss Shark
Special Summons itself and searches Crystal or Buzzsaw Shark, enabling instant Rank 4/5 Over-Hundred Numbers.
Buzzsaw Shark
One-card Rank 4 starter that summons a Level 4 Fish from the Deck.
Crystal Shark
Recursive extender from hand or GY that enables Rank 4 or Rank 5 Number Xyz Summons.
Silent Angler
Free Level 4 WATER extender from hand.
Seventh Tachyon
Reveals an Over-Hundred Number in the Extra Deck to search any monster matching its Type/Attribute or Level/Rank.
Seventh Ascension
Searches or stacks any 'Seventh' Spell/Trap or 'Barian's' Spell/Trap, including Rank-Up-Magic The Seventh One.
Barian's Chaos Draw
Stacks a Seventh Spell or sends a Rank-Up-Magic from Deck to summon 2 monsters and Xyz Summon.
Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One
Activated when drawn during the Draw Phase or copied by Chaos Draw to cheat out an Over-Hundred Number and its Chaos upgrade.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force
Ranks up a Rank 4 Xyz into a Rank 5 Chaos Number or CXyz monster and steals an opponent's Xyz Material.
Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force
Ranks up any Rank 4 Xyz Monster into any Rank 5 Number C monster.
Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos
Quick-Play Rank-Up-Magic that upgrades a Number monster into its Chaos counterpart during the Battle Phase.
Barian Untopia
Field Spell that protects Number C, CXyz, and Over-Hundred Numbers from targeting and effect destruction.
Seventh Eternity
Continuous Trap that revives Over-Hundred Numbers and attaches Number C monsters to them.
extra: Rank 7 boss that can be summoned over any Number C101-C107, gaining 1000 ATK per material and copying a GY Number's effect.

Core Over-Hundred Number that absorbs an opposing Special Summoned monster.
Chaos upgrade that absorbs any Special Summoned monster and revives itself from the GY.
Rank 4 WATER Over-Hundred Number for Seventh Tachyon and quick disruption.
Rank 4 Over-Hundred Number for Seventh One and Seventh Tachyon.
Rank 5 Chaos upgrade that pops a backrow and negates monster effects.
Rank 4 Over-Hundred Number that provides monster effect negation.
Rank 5 Chaos upgrade that negates all face-up cards on the field.
